newsitem.title: USA: Fed seen adding reserves via overnight system RPs.
newsitem.headline: Fed seen adding reserves via overnight system RPs.

text.p: The Federal Reserve was expected to add temporary reserves to the banking system through overnight system repurchase agreements on Wednesday, economists said.
"It's the end of the maintenance period and I think they're just mopping up," said Astrid Adolfson, first vice president and senior economist at MCM MoneyWatch Inc.
At 0930 EDT/1330 GMT, federal funds were trading at 5-9/16 percent, above the Fed's 5-1/2 percent target for the rate.
